rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Christa Steyn
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2012).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in before 2012 as 'Christa Steyn'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, light pink edges. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
